items.html: And behold, these kings have not yet finished being purified until the days of the Messiah, for then they will be purified completely, and the dross will be nullified, in the secret of “He will swallow up death forever,” and the good within them will be purified and joined with holiness; and throughout the duration of this time, it is purified little by little each day, and with the coming of the Messiah, they will be completed in their purification.
